body.name: \(\theta^{\mathrm{sp}}\)
body.construction: On \(1\to2\) with node \(3\) isolated, set \(h(z)=2z-1\), \(q_i(z)=4\exp(4z)/(\exp(4)-1)\), \(p_2(y\mid x)=1+0.1h(x)h(y)\), and \(p_1=p_3=1\); obtain other sign vectors by reflecting each coordinate \(z\mapsto1-z\) when its prescribed sign is negative.
